summary: Energy Transfer LP filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a registered public offering of $650M Series 2026A and $1.1B Series 2026B Junior Subordinated Notes due 2057. The notes were issued under a 2022 indenture with supplemental indentures and a prospectus supplement filed July 6, 2026. This is a routine debt financing transaction, not a special situation. No special-situation elements are present; the filing solely discloses a material definitive agreement and creation of a direct financial obligation.
